selection_basis: Development-selected scenario profiles. Both methods, seed 9101, same per-case settings. Older unfavorable and failed profiles remain in their original cohort folders. No held-out-seed claim.

original.reason: Required original compact A/B geometry and middle-passage field.

reversed.reason: Exact negative of the required original physical field.

courtyards.reason: Four-courtyard monitoring and directed outer-street flow.

exhaust.reason: Sheltered staging and feasible side approaches to local exhaust inspection.

slalom.reason: Continuous survey, opposed outer-street flow and a sheltered central street.

atrium.reason: Gated inner/outer monitoring, south/east jets and sheltered west approach.

freight.reason: Revised after corridor stalls: service aisles admit the common controller clearance; the loading-lane jet still penalizes direct transfers.

perimeter.reason: Selected circulation opposes the blind default tour. The opposite-flow counterexample is retained separately.

interchange.reason: Revised after weak long missions: horizontal branch jets and sheltered vertical branches provide feasible alternatives.

distributed.reason: Rerun after a contact, with the same larger execution and geometric route clearance for both planners.
